payload.question: 上个月的 GMV 和毛利率

metrics.label: GMV
metrics.description: 已支付订单的实付金额合计。包含之后整单退款的订单，不包含已取消（未支付）订单。

metrics.label: 毛利率
metrics.description: 毛利额 ÷ 已支付且未退款订单的商品实付。

answer.text: 上个月（2026年9月），GMV为 46.78 万元。同期，毛利率为 30.1%（毛利额 12.97 万元，未退款商品实付 43.10 万元）。

queries.title: GMV
queries.sql:
SELECT
  ROUND(SUM(o.pay_amount), 2) AS gmv
FROM orders AS o
WHERE
  o.status IN ('paid', 'refunded')
  AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-30'
LIMIT 1000

queries.title: 毛利率
queries.sql:
SELECT
  ROUND(SUM(oi.pay_amount - oi.quantity * p.unit_cost), 2) AS gross_profit,
  ROUND(SUM(oi.pay_amount), 2) AS paid_sales,
  ROUND(
    SUM(oi.pay_amount - oi.quantity * p.unit_cost) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(oi.pay_amount), 0),
    4
  ) AS gross_margin
FROM order_items AS oi
JOIN orders AS o
  ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN products AS p
  ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE
  o.status = 'paid' AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-30'
LIMIT 1000

  ROUND(SUM(oi.pay_amount - oi.quantity * p.unit_cost), 2) AS gross_profit,
  ROUND(SUM(oi.pay_amount), 2) AS paid_sales,
  ROUND(
    SUM(oi.pay_amount - oi.quantity * p.unit_cost) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(oi.pay_amount), 0),
    4
  ) AS gross_margin
FROM (
  SELECT
    item_id,
    line_amount,
    order_id,
    pay_amount,
    product_id,
    quantity,
    unit_price
  FROM order_items
) AS oi

  SELECT
    channel,
    customer_id,
    discount_amount,
    gross_amount,
    order_date,
    order_id,
    pay_amount,
    refund_amount,
    region_id,
    status,
    store_id
  FROM orders
) AS o
  ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN (
  SELECT
    brand,
    category,
    product_id,
    product_name,
    unit_cost,
    unit_price
  FROM products
) AS p
  ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE
  o.status = 'paid' AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-30'
LIMIT 1000
